2100 -> 1901, on the tree left by rebasing this branch onto origin/19.0-marin, and measured there twice.

  origin/19.0-marin, worktree   2020   (its committed floor says 2019)
  this branch, worktree         1901
  this branch, in the workspace 1901

Measured the way typecheck.yml prescribes: npx tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit, counting `error TS`, TypeScript 5.9.3 as package-lock.json pins it. The two trees compile with an identical package.json and package-lock.json, so the -119 between them is this branch's work and nothing else: the two default-deny locks and the declaration defects behind them, unchanged in kind from the -119 this branch measured before the rebase.

THE INHERITED UNIT IS ORIGIN'S, NOT THIS BRANCH'S. origin/19.0-marin measures 2020 against its own committed 2019, and no commit has touched a .js or .ts file since a0342c72b96 set that floor -- cd76e5adf99, the only one after it, is documentation. The floor did not reproduce when it was set. This environment is not the suspect: it reproduces a0342c72b96's c901_addons floor (75) exactly on origin's own tree, and the eslint and mypy floors it set compose to this tree's measurements to the unit (23510 - 286 = 23224 measured; 1071 - 29 = 1042 measured). Three of the four reproduce; tsc is the one that does not, so the floor is set to what the tree holds rather than to 1900, which is 2019 - 119 and would carry origin's missing unit forward silently.

If CI reads 1900 the difference is that unit and nothing else: re-measure origin's tree first, not this one.

Cross-repo caveat for whoever re-measures: tsconfig.json maps some specifiers into ../enterprise, which CI does not check out. Measured both ways here -- workspace (siblings present) and detached worktree (absent) -- and both read 1901, so the mapping does not move this number.
